name: @oge-ui/charts
description: Signal-based Angular charts: line/spline/area/bar/stacked/scatter/range/candlestick series and pie/doughnut on a dependency-free SVG kernel — calendar-true time axes, log axes, zoom & pan, crosshair, shared tooltips, interactive legend and full keyboard access. The only dependency-free Angular-native chart family. Source-available commercial license (free for evaluation and development).
author: kaya2m
